# Module Overview

## Intended Learning Outcomes

By successful completion of the module, you will be able to:

1. Describe the role of the different computer system components and their interactions
2. Explain how instructions are executed by a computer processor
3. Illustrate key computer architecture concepts such as instruction sets, memory hierarchy and data storage
4. Explain the role operating systems have in providing services and sharing

::: notes
From the DPD
The module’s lectures provide the fundamental aspects of computer systems and architectures,
covering hardware, software and networking. The practical sessions enable students to reflect on
the role of each computer component and understand how design choices impact data input,
process and output.
Independent Learning
Students are encouraged to explore and understand different approaches hardware and software
system design. Independent study and formative assessment also help students to assess an
appreciate the evolution of micro-processors, hardware and operating systems.
Intended learning outcomes
:::

## Topics covered

- Computer system organisation
- Memory organisation and management
- Assembly level programs
- Microprocessor design fundamentals (pipelined architecture, CPU)
- Operating systems architectures
- Resources and resource management
- Control unit operations

# Assessment

## Overview

- Formative assessments
  - Workshop activities throughout the course
  - Allows you to collaborate and get feedback
- Summative assessment
  - Two pieces of work
  - Makes up your module grade

# Formative assessment

- Workshop activities: 

  *Review and analysis of scenarios using different system components, with
emphasis on understanding the evolution of computer architecture*

- Workshop activity: 

  **Group presentation on the role of operating systems, in use case
scenarios**

## S1


#### Report on the role of core computer architectural components

- Worth 40%, 1400 word equivalent
- Discuss the impact on computing of developments in a chosen element of computer hardware during your chosen time period
- Analyse an LLM's response to the same question

## S2

#### Computer system design project (worth 60%)

- Worth 60%, 1600 word equivalent
- Design an embedded computer system
- Report on the design process, elementns of hardware architecture and operating system design you have used.
